model.name: MiniMax H3 pi-H3 DWD 2-Step — Pruned
model.description: Fast two-step H3 Frames generation on the Pruned checkpoint. This dedicated pi-H3 DWD model predicts its final frames directly from the trained pixel head, keeps H3 audio generation, and uses a fixed one-phase Euler schedule. Experimental texture detail may be softer than a regular VAE decode.

prompt: A five-second single take of a small glass greenhouse in the rain at dusk. A botanist gently places a glowing seed into dark soil as tiny green shoots unfurl. Water beads and runs down the glass; warm amber lamps glow inside. Soft rain, gentle leaves, and a quiet chime are audible.
